He was removed by two stewards.

During the heckling of RETSLAV remarkd by the audience were to the effect that he is - employed by the British; employed by Otto SERASSER; employed by Lord Vansittart, in the pay of the Polish Govt:, and receiving money from Hans JAEGER.
